tools.name: check_availability
tools.description:
To query available appointment slots on the calendar.

CRITICAL: This tool ALWAYS returns HTTP 200. A 200 does NOT mean success — you must READ the body and act on its contents, never assume.

On SUCCESS the body is: {"ok": true, "slots": [{"day": "YYYY-MM-DD", "time": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS", "iso": "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.000Z"}, ...]}
- "time" = The value for booking.
- "iso" = Reference only, not needed.
- ONLY offer/book slots literally in the slots list.

On ERROR the body is: {"ok": false, "error": "CODE", "message": "explanation"} — please correct the call and retry:
- "no_start_time": the day argument was missing. Retry with a concrete YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "invalid_slot_target_date": the date was missformatted. Retry with a valid YYYY-MM-DD date.
- "no_availability_in_window": no free slots in that window. Check the next available day and offer its closest slots.
- "upstream_unavailable": the calendar is temporarily down. Say you'll retry shortly, then retry.

account_id.description: Which calendar account to use. Fixed per agent — do not change.

slot_target_date.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the day the caller wants a slot for.

tools.name: extract_slot_details
tools.description: Extract the selected slot details. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: selected_slot_start
variables.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix — the exact start time from check_availability result. Required for transition.

variables.name: selected_slot_label
variables.description: The spoken form used when offering the slot, e.g. 'Thursday at 2 PM'

tools.name: trigger_slot_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to confirmation. Call ONLY after extract_slot_details has been called with non-null values.

variables.name: slot_selected
variables.description: Set to true to transition to confirmation

tools.name: extract_confirm_details
tools.description: Extract and lock in confirmation details. Pass actual values — never empty arguments.

variables.name: selected_slot_start
variables.description: ISO 8601 UTC with Z suffix — the new slot start time

variables.name: selected_slot_label
variables.description: The new spoken form, e.g. 'Friday at 10 AM'

variables.name: booking_slot_string
variables.description: Copy the exact value of selected_slot_start (ISO 8601 UTC). Required for transition.

tools.name: trigger_confirm_transition
tools.description: Trigger the transition to booking. Call ONLY after extract_confirm_details has been called and customer has confirmed.

variables.name: booking_confirmed
variables.description: Set to true ONLY after customer has confirmed the slot

tools.name: explicit_confirmation
tools.description: set explicit_confirmation to true ONLY when the customer has verbally confirmed the exact slot that was read back. Never set it to true after the customer merely gives a name or phone number, or says anything that is not an absolute clear yes. If there is no explicit verbal agreement, set it to false. --

variables.name: explicit_confirmation
variables.description: true ONLY when the customer verbally confirmed/agreed to the slot offered

tools.name: book_calendar
